purpose: exhaust every retained active BTC ETH and SOL long-option plus equal opposite USDT perpetual terminal-payoff lower bound before considering one exact option-depth request

retained_lineage.role: source-bound crypto option perpetual identity population and HTTP observation-window correction
retained fee funding basis tick capital and quantity stress semantics

identity.call_construction: buy one European call at displayed ask and short one equal-unit matching USDT perpetual at displayed bid
identity.call_terminal_gross_floor_per_unit: perpetual_entry_bid minus strike minus call_ask when the perpetual is exited at the option settlement underlying before basis funding and costs
identity.put_construction: buy one European put at displayed ask and long one equal-unit matching USDT perpetual at displayed ask
identity.put_terminal_gross_floor_per_unit: strike minus perpetual_entry_ask minus put_ask when the perpetual is exited at the option settlement underlying before basis funding and costs

stress.funding_long_perpetual_rule: never credit negative funding and use worst exact-length positive-rate rolling sum or worst 90-event positive-rate average extrapolation
stress.funding_short_perpetual_rule: never credit positive funding and use worst exact-length absolute-negative-rate rolling sum or worst 90-event absolute-negative-rate average extrapolation

decision.gross_gate: evaluate all 1410 active eligible options and retain only positive displayed option-ask plus executable-side perpetual-entry terminal floors
decision.stress_gate: require positive headroom after exact common minimum quantity futures top-level capacity 33.5 bips fixed fee and exit-basis stress two adverse ticks per leg direction-specific adverse funding 1.25 funding notional multiplier and two-notional 10 percent annual capital hurdle
decision.option_depth: the retained all-option ticker has no ask quantity so even a stress survivor authorizes only one separately frozen exact option-depth request for the deterministic highest after-stress-bips row
decision.tie_break: descending after-stress bips then lexical option symbol
decision.accepted_edge: never from this retained screen or one snapshot; exact option depth current synchronized futures depth exact account fees recurrence and owned settlement remain mandatory
decision.no_survivor: terminalize this retained single-option population and stop with zero requests

prohibited_shortcuts: using option mark last trade model value or bid instead of the displayed ask
using perpetual mark or index instead of the executable entry book side
assuming perpetual expiry exit equals the option settlement index
crediting favorable funding or ignoring option futures settlement basis tick capital or orphan costs
treating absent option ask quantity as executable capacity
requesting depth for more than the deterministic top retained-stress survivor
calling a retained historical snapshot current recurring profit or deployment ready
using credentials accessing accounts accepting contracts or placing orders
